content.title: Watch the Warriors vs Suns tonight in an NBA Play-In showdown; time, live stream, odds
content.text: Phoenix Suns mascot "The Gorilla" during the first half of an NBA basketball game against the Atlanta Hawks, Wednesday, Feb. 1, 2023, in Phoenix. (AP Photo/Rick Scuteri)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveTonight’s NBA slate features the Golden State Warriors taking on the Phoenix Suns in this exciting NBA Play-In game. These teams are battling for the 8 seed in the Western Conference bracket of the NBA Playoffs. The tip takes place at 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MST) on Friday, April 17, and the only way to watch is streaming on Amazon Prime.What TV channel is the Warriors vs. Suns NBA play-in game on tonight, or is it streaming only?When: 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MST) on Friday, April 17Where: Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, AZWhat TV channel is the game on? Amazon Prime Video is not a TV channel, and there is no TV broadcast for this game. This game is only available to watch live streaming on Amazon Prime.How to watch the game streaming live: You have to sign up for Amazon Prime ($14.99/month or $139.00/year) to watch this game live on your TV, computer, phone, or tablet with the Prime app. To sign up, follow the instructions on Amazon Prime, and it will walk you through the process. Once you have signed up, you can download the Amazon Prime app (for Apple/iOS or for Google Android) and sign in on your phone, computer, smart TV or other streaming device.What are the Golden State Warriors vs. Phoenix Suns spread, latest betting oddsSpread: PHO: -3.5Over/Under: 219.5Get promo codes, signup deals, and free bets from our Oregon Betting News home page.Suns vs Thunder goes live tonight: Everything you need to know about how to watch Game 2Watch the Penguins vs Flyers streaming for free tonight; TV channel, time, betting oddsHow to watch Magic vs Pistons in Game 2 for free today; NBA Playoffs start time, channel, oddsJohn's focus is on helping readers find ways to watch live sports and experience them in person.
